name: Exact-coordinate duplicate share
definition: Share of geolocated published points that share exact coordinates (0.01 m) with at least one other published point (single-linkage; excess = points - clusters)
target: <0.01 after resolution; any remainder labelled as multi-camera mount
note: Same-source 0.1064; cross-source 0.0199. Part is several cameras on one mount (legitimate); most is double ingestion (see M05)

name: Cross-layer duplicate share at 25 m
definition: Share of geolocated points that have a point from a different source OR a different upstream layer (target) within 25 m (union-find; excess = points - clusters)
method: KD-tree + union-find over pairs whose source/target differ (tools/round2.py)
target: equal to resolver merges within 1 pp and published as one site
note: Sensitivity: 1 m 0.1053; 10 m 0.1178; 25 m 0.1346; 50 m 0.1569. Estimated distinct points at 25 m = 196736

name: Dedup-ratio sensitivity to distance
definition: 1 - clusters/points for single-linkage over all pairs within threshold
target: a stated threshold with a curve that flattens near it
note: The curve never flattens: beyond 10 m single-linkage chains distinct nearby cameras; a distance-only rule cannot define 'same site'. The resolver's 0.0375 sits below even the exact-coordinate floor

name: Resolver capture of cross-layer duplicates
definition: Resolver dedup ratio (latest camera-site run) versus measured cross-layer duplicate share at 25 m
value: 0.0375 vs 0.1346 (8724 merges; 11106 auto-write pairs; 33907 proposed awaiting review; 0 human decisions)
target: resolver ratio within 1 pp of the measured duplicate share
note: Resolver merges about 28% of the measured cross-layer duplicates; 26168 pairs held back by a max-span cluster constraint

name: Mirror double counting
definition: Share of a mirror layer's points with a point from its origin/sibling layer within 25 m
value: alpr_nationwide->DeFlock republish 0.695 (13238 of 19044); Nottingham<->Mark43 0.998; Toronto<->CoT GeoHub 0.975; MD open data<->Esri dashboard 0.942; 7 layers ingested twice under two target ids at 1.000
target: 0 double-published mirror points (mirror marked as mirror; counted once)
note: The two OSM republishes share one source id; the resolver lists 11 mirror lineages but the release still publishes every row (n_sources=1 on all rows)

name: Multi-source sites published
definition: Published site rows with n_sources > 1
target: >0 wherever sources corroborate (at least 274 per resolver)
note: Every published row is observation-level; resolved sites (223901) are not exported

name: Subject-key collisions
definition: Camera subjects carrying two or more differing current camera_latitude claims (distinct upstream records collapsed onto one id by a non-unique upstream ref)
value: 5278 subjects (2.27% of 232627); 4520 with spread >= 10 km; up to 242 claims on one subject
method: read-only SELECT grouping current claims by subject
note: IL DOT 2936 (97.9% of its layer); FL 511 two layers 1964; these are the release's 5290 'conflicted' points withheld from the map

name: Claim-level redundancy
definition: Share of current claims that repeat an existing (subject; predicate; value)
method: count(*) vs count(DISTINCT subject; predicate; md5(value))
target: ~0 (re-observation recorded as a dated observation instead)
note: Every EFF Data Driven claim appears twice; procurement claims 2-3x; one camera ref re-inserted 58 times in one run

name: Same agency under several unlinked ids
